# Game Idea: Canvas Runner

A minimalist endless runner rendered on an HTML canvas. The player controls a continuously moving character that can jump to avoid randomly generated obstacles (spikes, gaps, moving platforms). The background scrolls to create the illusion of forward motion. The game ends when the character collides with an obstacle or falls off the platform.

**Lose condition:** Collision with any obstacle or falling off the screen.
